_README: CONSTRUCTION ROADMAP DATA — drives the timeline on the Progress
HOW TO UPDATE when a phase completes (example: classrooms done):
1. On the finished phase: change 'label' from 'NOW' to the real
2. On the next phase: change 'label' to 'NOW' and 'status' to
3. Save, commit, push. Dots and colors update themselves.
label  — small text above the title: a date for finished phases,
or NOW / NEXT / THEN for future ones
Only ONE milestone should be 'current' at a time.
done = solid navy dot; current = glowing gold dot;
